HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE.finding: The exact issuer retains source reviews and a governed score or isolated score readback.

FINANCIAL_MAPPING.finding: The retained evaluated scope has a governed dataset receipt or readback. No reproducible raw-to-consumer discrepancy was established for these rows.

METRIC_COMPUTABILITY.finding: The reviewed limited artifact does not establish computability outside its bound scope.

PIT_ADMISSIBILITY.finding: Current-purpose evidence and later review clocks do not establish historical PIT admission.

RUBRIC_FEASIBILITY.finding: Existing N/R dispositions remain limited to their retained baseline and scoped approvals.

VALUATION_READINESS.finding: Retained valuation evidence is bounded to the scope and confidence of the original case.

DECISION_DEPENDENCIES.finding: The evaluated scoring material does not establish a complete authorized M6.5 candidate.

FINANCIAL_METRICS.finding: Retained matching-period components support the existing analytical scope. Normalization and forward judgment are reviewed separately.

SHARE_DENOMINATOR.finding: Reviewed issuer share basis is retained. No incompatible denominator defect was established in the selected scope.

ACTION_COMPARABILITY.finding: The reviewed current-use share/economics basis does not qualify unrestricted historical total-return or PIT comparisons.

CASH_FLOW_NORMALIZATION.finding: BANK review uses common earnings and capital on a comparable basis. Industrial free cash flow is inapplicable.

SECTOR_METHOD.finding: Existing BANK equity methods use sustainable ROE, cost of equity and capital constraints. Do not infer industrial EV from deposit funding.

ASSUMPTIONS.finding: Sustainable ROE and consistent forward NIM, provision and capital path remain insufficient to defend a valuation band.

SCENARIOS_SENSITIVITY.finding: The retained sensitivity crosses valuation bands and depends on forward capital and risk assumptions.

DISCOUNT_AND_RETURN.finding: Ke and normalized ROE leave a wide premium range without a robust primary band.

CONFIDENCE.finding: Primary valuation is N/R and the limited artifact is not ranking eligible.

PIT_INTEGRITY.finding: Current scoping is supported by existing receipts. Historical PIT approval is outside the retained current case.

SCORECARD_VALIDITY_CONFIDENCE.finding: The limited artifact has a null full score and is ineligible for ranking or allocation.

STAGE0_VETO.finding: Scoring M1 evidence exists. Formal M6.5 Stage 0 and veto evidence matching the decision scope was not verified in this audit.

THESIS.finding: Retained scoring and research thesis evidence lacks an adopted M6.5 human thesis review in this packet.

VALUATION_FORWARD_RETURN.finding: The valuation audit leaves material scope or confidence limitations.

RESIDUAL_RISK_HURDLE.finding: The retained packet does not bind a decision-specific residual-risk and hurdle calibration.

OWNERSHIP_CONCENTRATION.finding: This audit contains no matched authoritative M6.3 decision snapshot.

OPPORTUNITY_COST.finding: No decision-scope comparison set was verified in the retained case.

TECHNICAL_OVERLAY.finding: No decision-scope overlay was evaluated here. The native decision policy governs applicability.

CASH_BOARD_LOT.finding: No matched execution-capacity packet was verified. Values cannot be inferred from the score.

DECISION_AUTHORIZATION.finding: The retained research and scoring permissions do not confer decision or trade authorization.
